notes.title: Update 1.1.92
notes.content:
-Fixed a crash involving pet DB if not connected to the net.
-Rip and pet restore are now fully automated
-Cleaned up the serverlist class update code to prevent servers from displaying incorrect class information
-Can now Left click hold on most mults to level them quickly
-Enchanter Gear buff removed from Boots
-Removed Token Mult from Tokens
-Chest and Helm Re-scaled
-Exotic will drop when killing a wallboss equal to your current max stage and the level will be +1000 over your current level. Basically a really nice rewarding upgrade for pushing.
-Scaled down war stage skip
-Re-scaled Class level system
-Added Class Evolutions every 1000 class levels you will get a quest. Once quest is complete you can keep leveling and you will recieve 1 evolution gem to use to evolve heroes
-Added Hero Evolutions Heroes now have 7 Rarity levels that can be leveled with Evolution gems each level gives them 1000x Base Damage. Heros will have different costs.
-Added guild Tag to class boards. Blank names will appear til everyone is on current build.
-Buffed Neck Gear by 100%
-Ending Season those below 30k Max stage get x2 Returns those over get mixed returns.
-Class levels and class XP reset, Token mult set to 3000 for everyone(buff to everyone except a few).
-Gear Reset has been reset as well happy farming!
-Enchanter now buffs helm and chest.

notes.title: Update 1.1.62
notes.content:
-Gear System has Arrived! 

This was changed a bit in testing... Currently Each time you prestige you are awarded with 25 pieces of gear that spawns in the middle of the screen. It will be automatically picked up after 30 seconds if you don't mouse over it.  Gear stats are dependant on the stage you prestiged on.  If you dont wish to use the Inventory Button you can hit "i" to open and close the inventory.  Equip gear by using your scroll wheel or arrow keys to highlight the gear and click use to equip. Gear was intended to be one of the stronger systems to influence stage gains.

-Gambler Removed
-Season has ended
-New players recieve 2k Tokens on first login.(Free first class)
-Removed Breakthrough on Token Pickup
-Fixed some display issues on wave compression
-Released Token Pet DLC

notes.title: Update 1.1.58
notes.content:
-Number system overhaul completed. This has used up a full week of development time but knowing we have no limits now I can start to improve balance in future updates.  
-Added Bracket based scoreboards that display the Max stage of players in your bracket.
-All new numbers are in Scientific notation, will give an option to use old number display in a future update.
-Increased Scoreboard update frequency and score uploads.
-Clicky now uses Magmas discount as his own.
-Added a loading screen for those opening the game while over stage 7k(game now loads hero levels and costs and works based on that going forward so calculations are quicker)

I expect some minor bugs to be lingering around still... If you find anything game breaking please report it ASAP also expect a hotfix if something is found...

Gear System will be the next major update. This may take a few days to a week.

notes.title: ClickRaid Development Roadmap 2017 - 2018
notes.content:
1. Fix any remaining bugs related to the big number conversion.(Ongoing)
2. Add a gear system that plays a major role in progression.
3. Add Boss mechanics for special pet events.
4. Remove gambler at the end of season.

6. Add more unique quests to the game to unlock what would have been season pets and cursors.(Monthly)
7. Add Tier Leaderboards so the number 1 spot is always withing 1k levels :)
8. Give out better rewards for those that place in competitions.
9. Add Elemental dungeons that let you earn a unique pet.
10. Add Dragon dungeons 
11. Improve Guild Interface
12. Re-work the UI
13. Translate the game into other languages.
14. Release Pet that collects all tokens
15. Class cursors 
16. More steam achieves
 
No guarentees on when this will be finished but between community suggestions and this list I hope to have most of this complete before Christmas :)  

This week has been all about the number conversion and its been driving me nuts to not add content but once this is complete and released i'll start work on the Gear system next.

-Fixed a few music issues like the FPS drop on serverlist when music is playing from inside a game.
-Disabled the Halloween event but kept the background by request

notes.title: Update 1.1.46
notes.content:
Sorry about not posting patch notes for yesterday, most was just trying to optimize code and find memory leaks causing FPS drops.

Anyhow this patch will hopefully cover all current issues.

-Adv damage calculation fix had a + instead of a * for the fire arrow mult.
-Ninja finally getting a buff(sorry needed to see how it compared to other classes wasnt trying to ignore anyone, as i said several time in chat he will be fixed). Consider this a test of a fix. 
-Ninja will now buff firearrow to increase its stacks by hit projectile count and also for each level it will decrease the delay between the firearrow DOT ticks.
-Serverhost fix based on all the information i gathered the FPS drop might be due to just the sheer amount of packets the host has to send and calculate per second. The realtime mouse cursor movement seems to be the largest factor so im decrease its sync by about half. Once again if this doesnt fix the issue ill revert back but it will make other cursors movement slightly choppy and in the future i could fix this by handling movement like pet movement.
-General performance tweaks - I started using the same calculation that speeds up class projectiles on the heros with some success at decrease the amount of hero projectiles on the screen. Also i have removed the Blue XP objects from the monsters and am now just directly calculating the xp.
-Fixed merchant Xp not saving... Oops...
-Fixed some surfaces last night that wernt being cleared when they needed to be.

Next update will either be bug fixs from season related bugs or performance optimizations to account for the faster stage clearing.

Season starts around 8pm est possibly 9pm if i dont get off work early.

notes.title: Update 1.1.15
notes.content:
Sorry forgot to update patch notes yesterday....
-Added ability to migrate hosts in games
-A few bug fix builds to address bugs it added everything should be good now
-Fixed a chat bug..

Anyhow the way migration works currently is that when a host creates a server and a few users join the host must choose someone in the group that will take over as Host in the event that he gets disconnected or has to leave.  The entire group will see that he has chosen someone as the blue check box will have a green checkmark in it. I'll eventually start tracking if your able to host and make this completely automatic but for now its up to the current game host to make sure someone is lined up to take over. Remember not everyone can host due to some routers so communicate and see who wants to be the backup :)

I'll eventually start tracking if your able to host and make this completely automatic but for now its up to the current game host to make sure someone is lined up to take over. Remember not everyone can host due to some routers so communicate and see who wants to be the backup :)

notes.title: Update 1.1.05
notes.content:
-Fixed Enchanter buff level bug
-Fixed a Sorc buff level bug
-Completely recoded the Charm system(I like it much better now, not spoiling all the changes just got check it out!)
-Changed the way max level is calculated. Have tried 3 different ways to do this the fairest bestest way possible. I think its perfect now... 

Long explanation:
Old system we simply added your levels up, added all the levels that came from other players and generated a % of your contribution vs the group and returned buffs from that %... yea ppl hated that...

Next we took your max level class and then compared each classes level to yours. If they were higher they were reduced... If they were lower you recieved the full bonus. If 2 of the same class existed the same rules apply and you would get those additional levels. Subclass worked the same way except it used your max level class/2

New system:
Works the same as the last except how the max level is calculated. The new system Takes all your levels and all of your current XP and adds it up into one pool containing all the Class XP you have ever earned. Then it runs it through the same leveling formula all the heros go through(as if you played 1 class since you started playing a class). This spits out the highest level you could have achieved and is now your Max level to compare to others with.   The problem with the 2nd system was it punished you for not playing a single class. New system lets you play anything you want without preventing you from recieving the buff levels you deserve.  This system had to be developed to prevent high levels from making the game to easy on the lower level players that were just hitting 650.
